title: MJF’s reign: Regal, Danielson & the Four Pillars
summary: MJF captures the world title through betrayal and defends it against both an established great and AEW’s emerging generation.

chapters.title: Regal helps MJF become champion
chapters.result: MJF uses Regal’s brass knuckles to defeat Moxley.
chapters.context: Regal’s betrayal transfers the championship to MJF.

chapters.title: The Iron Man goes to sudden death
chapters.result: MJF defeats Danielson after the 60-minute match reaches overtime.
chapters.context: The champion survives Danielson’s endurance test.

chapters.title: The Four Pillars collide
chapters.result: MJF retains against Darby Allin, Jack Perry, and Sammy Guevara.
chapters.context: AEW’s four homegrown rivals meet with the championship at stake.
